home.title: Asan Kaam — Pakistan's Local Task Marketplace
home.heroHeading: Kaam Dhundo. Kaam Karo. Asan Hai.
home.heroBody: Asan Kaam connects people who need everyday tasks done with trusted, verified taskers right in their neighbourhood. From moving furniture in Lahore to fixing a leaky tap in Karachi — post a task in minutes and get competitive bids from nearby taskers.
home.cityBody: Asan Kaam is launching city by city across Pakistan. Pick your city to see tasks and taskers near you.
home.filtersBody: Narrow down the task feed using the filters below. Taskers can zero in on jobs that match their skills, schedule, and preferred area.
home.feedBody: Live tasks posted by people in your city. Tap any card to read the full details and submit your bid.
home.ctaBody: Post your task in under two minutes. Describe what you need, set your budget in PKR, and let verified taskers come to you with their best offers. No upfront payment — you choose who to hire.

postTask.title: Post a Task
postTask.categoryHeading: What kind of task do you need done?
postTask.categoryBody: Choose the category that best describes your task. This helps nearby verified taskers find your listing quickly.
postTask.detailsBody: A clear, specific description attracts better bids faster. Include what needs to be done, any tools or materials required, and any important instructions. Keep it factual — contact details will be shared only after you accept a bid.
postTask.locationBody: Select the city and area where the task will take place, then set a fair budget in PKR. Taskers will bid at or below your stated budget — you compare and choose.
postTask.timingHeading: When do you need it done?
postTask.timingBody: Set a preferred date and time window so taskers can plan around their schedule. You can also mark the task as flexible if timing is not critical.
postTask.boostHeading: Need it done urgently? Boost your task.
postTask.boostBody: An Urgency Boost pins your task to the top of the feed in your selected city for 24 hours, putting it in front of more verified taskers. The boost fee is shown below before you confirm — no hidden charges.
postTask.reviewBody: Check the details below before publishing. Once posted, your task goes live as 'Open' and verified taskers in your area can start placing bids. You can edit or cancel the task from My Tasks as long as no bid has been accepted.

myTasks.title: My Tasks
myTasks.filtersBody: Track every task you've posted — from open bids to completed jobs. Use the filters below to find exactly what you need.
myTasks.cardsBody: Each card shows the key details you need to act fast — status, bid count, budget, and location — so you never miss a step.
myTasks.actionsBody: Take the right action at every stage. Available options update automatically based on your task's current status — no guesswork needed.
